message_content: Please note: Your bank detected a problem. Send the verification code to secure your account.
indicators: Requests for passwords, OTPs, or account verification
explanation: The message claims to be from a bank reporting a problem and urgently requests a verification code to secure the account. Legitimate banks never ask customers to send verification codes or OTPs via SMS or phone calls. This is a classic tactic used by scammers to gain unauthorized access to bank accounts.
recommendation: Do not reply to the message or share any verification codes, passwords, or personal information. Contact your bank directly using the official customer service number found on the back of your card or their official website to verify if there are any issues with your account.
